src:
Hahahaha! We have those Gringos
exactly where we want them!

Generalissimo, you're not planning to
take on the entire Yankee army?

You don’t expect me to answer
a stupid question like that? Prepare the artillery!
Ándale, Ándale!
This will teach those gringos to cross the Rio Grande!
No uniform, he must be a spy.
Bring him to me!
Take him to the river and shoot him like a dog!

No, no, no! I'm not a spy, I’m a businessman.
Please! I was just trying to get across the river.
Please, I have gold. Lots of gold!
Ha ha. You lie to save your pathetic life.
No! It’s true! It's true! I have gold!
Bring him to me!

It’s lots of gold, more gold than you've ever seen.
A gold mine, and it's just over the border
in the territory!
If you spare my life, I can give you half.
Why shouldn't I take all of it?
Cause you don't know where it is.

You better speak fast.
We need some privacy. . .
now tell me more about this gold mine.

Truth be told, there is one little problem.
I only own half the claim.
My partner Nate owns the other half.
And what if I kill your partner?
Then that would make us. . . partners.

Partner!
Hahahahaha!
We’re being raided!
I want him alive. I have questions for this one...
Take him to the Gold Mine!
What? Did you forget how to use those rifles!
I have had enough!

A thousand pieces in gold to the man
who brings me that gringo's head.

It’s been a week since General Diego
captured me.
I don't know nothing about bounty hunting,

but I’ve been a slave once and
ain’t never going do it again.
Cousin Red?
Shadow wolf?

I knew I'd find you!
The blood bond between us is strong.

I’ll go to Brimstone.
I’ll have the Cavalry here in no time!

Go fast, Soldier.  Unless we separate
we'll have no chance for escape.

I will go this way and
meet you at Diego’s fort.

I just need one more week! I can pay you
the $5,000 that I owe, but the Governor is bribing

my ranch hands to leave,
I can't do it by myself.

Well, why don't you just sell up to the Governor.
You could always move into town
and work in the saloon.

The Saloon! How dare you!
I just need one more week!
I don't think the owner of the bank would approve.
Well maybe I can speak with him myself.

I’m sorry, but the governor is too busy
for the likes of you.

To hell with that evil son of a bitch! He’s mined
enough gold out of Bear Mountain!
What the hell does he want with my damn ranch!
Ma'am?
I’m sorry, sir. How may I be of assistance?
I want my money!
We have a small problem.

Then tell me about the gold in bear mountain
that young lady was talking about.
I’m sorry I can’t disclose anything about our clients.

Then tell me where she lives.
And when I get back, you better have my gold!
All I'm saying, is if it was me that lost an arm,

Well maybe, but a cannon?
Well that's too much gun for any man!

Cork your whisky holes.
You didn't know him before, like I did.

Only a cannon could replace that
man’s arm.
How did he lose his arm?

We ain't telling you nothing stranger!
Near as I can tell, we ain't even talking to you!
Take a walk!
Answer my question and I'll be on my way.

Well shut up! Don't tell this stinking
prairie dog nothing!
Ain't that right, Sam?
I reckon so. . .
Say goodbye, Mister.

Your pretty handy in a fight, stranger,
but you lost your guns in all the ruckus,
here they are.

I guess you’ve still got some business with
them brothers.
They ain’t what you’d call kindly fellows.

Well, good luck to you, but I got to look out for
myself, so this door is getting locked behind you.

Your pretty good in a fight, stranger.
The only problem is you lost your guns
in all the ruckus.
Here you go.

Looks like you still got some business
with them brothers.
They ain’t what you call kindly fellows.
Open the damn door, woman!
Well, good luck to you,

but I got to look out for myself,
so this door is getting locked behind you.
Hey, friend.
Follow me, I know a short cut.

Friend! You go ahead,
I’ll follow you!

I could hear your coming, little man.
You think you can handle taking
on a woman like me?
You either drunk or crazy.
Hate to kill a lady.

There are too many of them. The bridge must
be destroyed. Set the charges where you must.
But general that would be suicide.

It certainly will be if you don’t.
Ándale! Ándale!
Hahahahahahaha!

Finally. We just been killing time since
Mr. Kelley made us guard this hole in the ground,
but it looks like things are picking up.
That's bad luck for you, stranger.
Cousin!

If we wait much longer for the cavalry
they will be rescuing our corpses.

If we attack that gatling gun head on we'll both die.
I’ll draw their fire while you try to find
a way inside the walls.
Revenge shall be mine!

Many are the dead who have prayed for this moment.
You have done well Red, but his master,
Diego, still lives.

That’s Diego’s war train
Go, cousin, finish what you have started.

Our people now shall know of your courage,
cousin.
Excuse me, excuse me, sir.

I seem to have found myself in a most
unfortunate situation.
If you would be kind enough to help me.
You ain’t my problem.

Indeed sir, however, you might feel
differently once you look behind you.

I’m guessing there’s more where they came from.
That contraption should make short
work of them. I’ll cover you.
You’re going to blow up real good, cowboy!

Thank you sir, your help has been immensely
appreciated. If I can be of any assistance whatsoever,
do not hesitate to call on me.

Now, if you’ll excuse me,
I have a certain debt to collect from
Professor Perry and his circus crew.
Good day to you.
Your judgment day has come.
PSST! Whoa! Easy there, uh, friend!

Come over here. Come on now.
It’s too dangerous for a man to be walking
around in these parts!
I deal in weapons and goods. See?

I would offer you more than,
hehehe but a gang of ruffians done run me

offa my, oh uh,
well I didn't uh,

You holding out on us, old man?
No!
What the hell you looking at?
Fill him full of lead!
I’m going to make mincemeat out of you!
Damn, son! You done killed them all!

You know you can get quite a handsome
bounty for these fellas,

if you took them down to Sheriff O’Grady
in Widow’s Patch.
I’ll be taking your cart.

Uh, well uh, sure, whatever
you say, bounty hunter.

Well, it’s been a week since General Diego
captured me.
I know nothing about being a bounty hunter,

but I’ve been a slave once and
ain’t no way I’m gonna do it again.
Cousin Red?
Shadow wolf? Over here.

I knew I would find you;
the blood bond between us is strong.

I’ll go to Brimstone and get help.
I’ll have the Cavalry here in no time!

Go fast, Soldier.  We will have no
chance for escape unless we separate,

I will go this way and
meet you at Diego’s fort.

Anyone comes through that gate, you kill them.
I don’t care if it’s your Grannie’s ghost,

you put a bullet in between their eyes,
and you don't stop shooting that rifle until

you ain’t have no bullets left.
You understand me?

Let's see if we can find a way in
that will attract a little less attention.
I'll go round this way.
I’m going straight in.

I think a frontal assault is out of the question.
Suggestions?
Follow me. And shoot anything that moves.
Dammit!

The only thing left in my bag of tricks
is to pick the damn lock on the front door.

Think you two can keep me from
getting shot in the back while I do it?

Only one way to find out.
I'll cover you from up here with my rifle.
All right then mate, follow me!
I got it! Let’s go!

That no good Governor is going to be
sorry he burned down my ranch after
I get through with this fancy house.

I don’t think the Governor is going to be in
a position to care about much of anything soon.
Keep your heads down boys.

Right! A secret door! That’s the stuff!
Probably leads right to the bastard!

I'll keep these devils at bay,
you see where that passage leads.

I busted up the place something good,
found the keys to the whole place
on one of them dead bluejackets.

Still ain’t seen hide nor hair of that
sneaky Governor, though.

Let’s keep moving,
he’s got to be around here somewhere.
Hey soldier, ready to do some fighting?
Just point me in the right direction, ma'am.

You two go on and look for the governor.
I'm going to stay here and find Mr. Swift.
I’m afraid the Governor is otherwise occupied.

Next time, I suggest you make an appointment,
only there ain't going to be no next time.

You got no chance son,
best you just turn around and keep on going.
Ain’t no shame in cheating death twice.

I’ve got some nitro I found there in the Governor's
office, you lay down some fire and
I'll take that gate right down.

Best way to help me is to put a bullet in
that man's brain.
Get going, Bounty Hunter!

I always regretted what happened back
on your daddy's farm, Red.
I should have been there,
to make sure you joined them.
But lucky for me, I get a second chance.
Never did like him much.
Jack?

Well Red, I'm not saying Griffon didn’t
deserve it, but he was the Governor.

I reckon the army will be sniffing around here and…
well I’d hate to see you hang after all you’ve done.
$5000 in gold sound like a fair bounty?
It was never about the money. Give it to them.
Whoa!
Hey there, you going to Brimstone?

Close enough, I suppose.   The express road
passes about a mile outside of town.

Well, I gotta get to the governor so he can call out
the troops. There’s trouble heading from down South.
Well climb on back soldier.

Governor, you have to contact
General Bodie right away!
Who let you in here, Soldier?

There’s a renegade general named Diego in your
territory who’s running a gold mine using slave labour.

I’m afraid it’s a job only the U.S. Army can handle, sir.
He has an army of his own, and a fort, too!

Thank you soldier, in fact General Diego’s my biggest contributor.
I’m sure this is all a misunderstanding.
Mr. Kelly here will take good care of you.

Brimstone just a mile or so that away. Sorry I can’t take
you in, but there are some desperate folks
waitin’ for these here supplies.

Much obliged, mister.
I’ll be sure to tell the Governor you helped me.
Who knows, maybe there’s a reward in it for you.

If it’s all the same, I’d rather Governor Griffin
don’t even know who I am.
Good luck to you, soldier.

Darlin!
Pa!
Son! Our troubles are finally over!

We hit a vein of gold as wide as a locomotive
that runs clean through Bear Mountain!
Hey Pa, where did you get that?
Isn’t she a beaut?
Yeah! Can I hold it?
She’s one of a pair. Only 2 in the whole world.
Where's the other one?

My partner Griff has it.
We made them up special to symbolize
our new found wealth!
Can I try it out?

One day this fine weapon will be yours.
But for now why don’t you take my old pistol.

Go on down to the river and
practice while I give your Ma her gifts.

Red! Red Harlow!
What are you doing to my pots and pans!
Ha Ha. Now don’t henpeck the boy.

Next trip into town, I’ll
buy you a whole bunch of new pots and pans.

Red! Up the hill and quick, boy!
We’re getting raided!
I’m coming Pa!

No!
Don't!

Pa! Pa! Get up, pa!
Pa! Pa! Get up, pa! Pa! Pa!

Kid, I reckon your pa’s better off dead,
him being such a yellow-belly and all.

Sorry, Annie, but the Governor
made us a better offer.  Good luck. --SAM.
God not you, too, Sam!
I've got something for you!
Come out and play.
Ma’am.
Do I know you, stranger?
Tell me about the Gold Mine in Bear Mountain.
I know nothing about a gold mine.

You might want to take a trip on down
to the saloon in Brimstone.

It’s always littered with a
bunch of drunks yapping about it.

But watch yourself mister. You want no
business with the folks in that town.
This place is all I've ever known.
Ma’am.

Five thousand pieces in gold.
This’ll help me keep my ranch!

He’s killed so many men down south,
he had to come up north to find some more;
Senor Gabriel Navarro!!!

Challenging him,  a man of mystery.
Some of you may have heard of all the recent bounty
hunting he did on behalf of our the town.
Ladies and Gentleman…Red!

He’s killed so many men down south,
he had to come up north to find some more;
Senor Gabriel Navarro!

Challenging him, a man of mystery. Some of you
may have heard of all the recent bounty
hunting he did on behalf of the town.
Ladies and gentlemen, Red!
That should leave a bruise!

I don’t reckon he should be so eager to get
himself killed, but rules is the rules and there’s
no denying he’s quick on the draw.

He can’t shave but he sure can shoot,
the challenger, Kid Cougar!

Red, glad to see you made it through the preliminaries,
tomorrow should prove to be an exciting day.

I don’t think I’ve ever seen Kelley look nervous
before, something about you must have really
got under his skin.

I’m growing to like your more every day, Red.
If you win tomorrow, stop by my office.
I may have a job for you.

I wouldn’t be too cocky, Bounty Hunter.
Even a blind squirrel finds a nut from time to time.

Your bounty hunting exploits must have scared off the
real competition, which is the only reason
you made it this far.

One quick question, Bounty Hunter. . . shall I make it
quick and shoot you between the eyes?

Or shall I shoot you in the stomach,
and let you bleed to death?

Either way I will make sure you don’t live
long enough to see another sunset.

Make the most of your evening for
I intend it to be your last.

You won’t win tomorrow.  I saw you today and you
were as slow as a snail with two bad knees.

Mr Kelley is going chew you up and spit you out! And
then when me and him are celebrating tomorrow night,

you won’t be seeing nuthing but the insides of
a wooden box!

And then when they lay you to rest, you’ll be
right beside all the innocent men you've killed!

Evening, Red, me old china,  afraid I’ve had a
little too much to drink.  The fine gentleman

behind the bar keeps serving
a delicious elixir he calls Red-Eye.

I saw you duel earlier, you really are quite good, almost
as a good as I was in my heyday, but these days. . .
alas I’m little too fond of the sauce.

Can barely keep my hand steady these days,
so I think it’s time I hung up my holster for good,
maybe take things easier for a while.

So after I win tomorrow, I think I’ll find a nice gal
with a big piece of land to her name, and spend the

rest of days sipping whisky,
and telling lies about my days in the army.

Ah, the Bounty Hunter that the whole town's
talking about! What will it be?

That was some nice shooting out there, Bounty Hunter.
You got a steady arm and a good aim.
Governor could use a man like you.

Of course, the Governor can’t use you if your dead,
so you better be as good as you think
you are because Kelley is.

I wouldn’t make one mistake out there, partner,
not if you want to live long enough
to collect that prize money.

Hey Sugar, glad to see you made it this far.
I got my eye on you now, honey.

You do well tomorrow and
my oh my, we'll do some celebrating together.

You just make sure you don't let that Kelley
draw first, you hear me.  Because if he beats you to it,
you are going home in a wooden box.

For our semi-final round, we have a three time winner
and current champion,

the sharpest shooter and
dresser in the whole territory, Mister Kelley!

The brave soul challenging him is a man who's
killed a lot of bad men around here and is looking
to kill some more. . . Red!

Due to the sudden absence of Sheriff Bartlett,
I’m going to be stepping in to oversee this uh,
conclusion to the Battle Royale.

Now whereas the two gentlemen before us are clearly
the best, I believe a change of the rules is in order.
I hereby disqualify Jack Swift and Annie Stoakes.

The winner of this here round is going
to be the winner of the Battle Royale.
Well Red you’re good, I’ll give you that.

But of course you’d have to be to
live through what you did.

Still I'm afraid that we’re going to have to end
right here and now what we should have been ended
so many years ago.

Isn't she a beut?
Yeah! Can I hold it?

She's one of a pair.  Only 2 in the whole world.
Where's the other one?

Mr. Kelley, please join me at the mansion
when you’ve finally taken care of business.

Well, I guess I just lost my chance at
five thousand in gold.

A small price to pay to avoid
shooting you, madam.
Jack Swift, you’re just lucky to be alive.
Sheriff? Are you alright?
I’m alright!
Tell me where to find him.
His mansion!  But it’s secured like a fortress.
It’ll be hard even for a Bounty Hunter like you.
He will not be alone.

He ain’t the only one that wants the governor. I reckon
that there prize money is in that mansion of his.
I’m looking at a dead man.

Where you running off to sheriff?! You might
have beaten my gang, but you ain’t gonna get by me!

You cowards!
Somebody let me free!

Oh, Mister, mister, please!
You got to cut me loose!  Mister, please!
Who’s up for some barbeque?
Jack! What an unpleasant suprise.

That wasn't very nice Jack.
Don’t bet on making it out again.

That was incredible.
You saved my life!

All in a day's work. I only wish
it were more financially gratifying.

Well shoot, Mister, if getting yourself a little
money is all your worried about

then, I know where someone with your talent could
pick up five thousand dollars in gold
without even trying!

Pray do tell, young lady, and
I will be forever in your debt!

There’s a sharpshooter competion in Brimstone,
winner takes all.

Shouldn’t be a problem for such a
fine marksmen like yourself.
Well, madam.

Time for a little pick me up I think.
My boys will keep you busy.
All this excitement has made me quite thirsty!
Dammit, I've almost run dry.
Okay, Swift, I've had enough of you now.
Well look at what we got here!

If there’s anything I can’t stand, it’s
a varmint what don’t know it's own business.
Now the real show begins!
You the bounty hunter?

Sheriff Bartlett. I got your telegram.
Mighty grateful to you.

I may have some work for you.
Stop by my office later.

Come to try you hand at
the $5000 in gold I see.

You are a man of few words, I respect that.
I truly do.

I believe you are somewhat acquainted with
Miss Stoakes.
Did you find what you were lookin’ for, stranger?
I reckon’ I did.
Do you see a buffalo soldier ride into town.

That BOY!  He won't be causing
the governor anymore problems.

I do hope you are planning to attend the Battle Royale.
I would very much look forward to beating
an adversary of your talent.
I just signed up.
That should leave a bruise!

I don’t reckon he should be so eager to get
himself killed, but rules is the rules and there’s
no denying he’s quick on the draw.

He can’t shave but he sure can shoot,
the challenger, Kid Cougar!

Well I do declare, I had me such a fright the other
day.  One of my little ones got to drinking some

liver medicine I brought from a travelling
salesman . . .

Poor thing looked ever so sick, and I was quite
worried for him until I told him I was going

to take him to see Woody Klein to
see if he could help . . .

So little Jimmy starts throwing a temper tantrum,
and lo and behold, after all that rolling
around and shaking, he was as right as rain . . .

I don’t think Jimmy will be playing with
any more Mr. Perry’s potions in the future!

Good day to you, sir! I don’t supposed you
know what’s going on up Rogue Valley would you?

I need to get through that canyon
to see my sister who's ailing something
terrible over at Clementine Falls!

Bad Bessie and her gang have been holed up there
for weeks now, and there ain’t no traffic getting
through at all!

Somebody needs to get in there and
make it safe for decent people to travel!

I know you! You’re the fellow that took out
old Bad Bessie and her gang!

I got to give you my most gracious thanks. Now I can
make it up to Clementine Falls to see my ailing sister!

My word stranger, you are getting to be quite a
familiar face in these parts.  Why I stopped by the

Sheriff’s office just the other day and caught
the Governor talking of your exploits.

Seems he stopped by to see Sheriff Bartlett, and they
got to talking about a mysterious gunslinger that was
cleaning up the territory . . .

Governor Griffon wanted Bartlett to be sure not to
upset the balance and encourage undesirables to leave
the area.

I’m guessing the Governor wanted to be sure we
had plenty of entrants for the Battle Royale this year.

Now I don’t like to gossip, but I hear that
some people think that Mr Kelley has some
real competition this year.

I heard that that English gentleman who had that to do
up in Widow’s Patch has entered himself in
the competition.

And some folks are even claiming that Annie Stoakes
is going to enter this year. She needs the money to
sort out her financial issues.

Now if I wasn’t a god fearing soul, I’d be tempted to
place a wager on that you’ll be entering the competition,

especially with the way you’ve been handling
that pistol of yours recently.

Read all about it! – Governor announces sixth
annual Battle Royale!

Offers $5000 prize to the quickest draw
in the territory!

Title to be defended for the fourth year in a row
by Mr Kelley!
Fresh off the press!  Widow’s Patch saved by Limey!

Professor Perry perishes at the hands of
a travelling showman!
Bounty finally collected on Pig Josh!
Bad Bessie beaten by brave Bounty Hunter!

Rogue Valley to be renamed after Bounty Hunter
clears out bandits!
Governor to run for another term!

It’s the story of the century!  Read about how
one man stopped Nocturnicus!

Bounty claimed on the most wanted head
in the territory!
Sheriff Bartlett says we're safer than ever!
Battle Royale! Read about who’s entering this year!

Who’s going to win?  Four time champ Mr. Kelley?
Trickshooter Jack Swift, or maybe even local
ranch owner, Annie Stoakes.

Or will it be someone else, a late entrant perhaps.
Read all the speculation that’s fit to print!

Say you're new in town ain't you, stranger?
You got to have a look around
and see the sights while you’re here.

Well there is the canyon, that's awful pretty at sunset,
but there has been some trouble up that way.
You'd best avoid that.

Then there's the old fairground near Widow's Patch,
Mind you that bunch of no good circus folk hang
around there.

Well forget I mentioned it. You'd best stick to around
these parts,  Sheriff Bartlett does a keen job of keeping
the undesirables away from Brimstone.

Howdy, Stranger.  Hear you’ve been getting some
good use out of that shooting iron of yours.
Have you heard about our Battle Royale?

It’s a small competition the Governor throws to
bring folks to Brimstone, to find out who is the fastest
draw in the territory.

Draws in a lot of strange folk, I can assure you, but
none are as strange as the Kelley fellow that won
the competition for the last four years.

Rumor has it that he works for the Governor,
sorting out little problems that come up you know,

scaring away troublemakers before they
can make any trouble.

Hell if that fellow even looked at me the wrong way,
I’d be on the first stagecoach straight out of the state.
You’d best avoid him, stranger

You looking for work, Stranger?  I have a friend who
is hiring hard working folk.

She owns a small cattle ranch just a ways up yonder.
She's had trouble finding help recently.

Seems she's having trouble keeping good
workers around.

Bartrum Longhorn's boys, Hal and Luke, have taken
a shine to the property and trying to scare her away.

That won't work with Annie though, she's a tough one.
Her dead daddy's rifle will scare them troublemakers away.

What is the world coming too?  Have you heard about
the Stoakes' ranch being burnt to the ground?

Seems as Old Bart Longhorn's boys persuaded
a couple of workers to set light to
Annie Stoakes' house.

The fire burned out of control for two whole days,
now poor Annie ain't got nothing left,
even her cattle ran away.

Hey, you look like you’ve travelled around these parts.
I heard you was the one that saved
Sheriff O’Grady’s life.

I wonder what will happen to that town of his,
now that there are no lawmen left.

There are some bad sorts up that way and if word
gets to them that O’Grady ran a foul of Ugly Chris.

Well, it done turn my blood turn cold
just thinking about it.

You look like a man with a thirst, you must have
stopped by the Saloon by now, and seen
them pretty girls that Hanz Kenyon keeps around.

Hanz used to have a girl there went by the name of
Bessie. Could do things with a whip like
you wouldn’t believe!

Bessie claimed she would never miss with her whip,
though she often did, and she’d get right muddled
afterward and often end her act prematurely.

Well it happened once too many times for Bessie’s
liking, she saw this fellow laughing at her,

gave him a good licking with her whip, stole his
money and ran off into the hills or so I heard.

Howdy Stranger. Always nice to see a fresh face in
town.  You look like you could do with a bath,
a soft bed and the company of a fine woman . . .

We’ve got all that and more here, but if you are
after a drink, I’d talk to Hanz over by the bar.

But if your looking for a good time, Christina
should be awake in a couple of hours.
I’m sure she’ll be what you are looking for.

I’ve been hearing about you all over town,
talk is that you were the man who beat Bessie.

Bessie used to work here until she made off with the
takings, and left Hanz over there so scared of

whip cracks that he passes out each time the
stagecoach rides through town.

Hey there, sugar.  You look like a fellow who enjoys a
good time.  You should check out the show tonight!
I’ll kick extra high, just for you!

Hey Sugar, glad to see you made it this far.
I got my eye on you now, honey.  You do well tomorrow and
my oh my, we'll do some celebrating together…

You just make sure you don't let that Kelley
draw first, you hear me.  Because if he beats you to it,
you are going home in a wooden box.

There was some fancypants Englishman in town just
the other day claiming he was a famous trickshooter.

He was claiming that he had been hired, sight
unseen, by a world reknown circus troupe.

The only circus folk round here are the freaks that
belong to that charlatan snakeoil salesman,
Professor Perry.

That Englishmen better pray he don't run in to them.
Them circus folks just aren't right in the head.

Huh? Oh, howdy stranger!
Well, I was supposed to be delivering a load
of turnips up to Tarnation this morning.

But I got word from the general store that all deliveries
to Tarnation had been cancelled, indefinitely!

Apparently somebody by the name of Mr. Black is
calling the shots up there these days.

According to him, the good folks of Tarnation don’t
need food no more! What do you make of that?

You ask me, somebody has to take a ride out there
and see just what in blazes is going on.
